messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: perfdb-migration v2.3.1 -> prod on replicas shards-01..04. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/perfdb-migration 

sam: ETA on lock duration? this is on the critical path for checkout writes

irene: plan is advisory locks per-table, short-lived (<=5s) during schema swap, backfill uses chunked updates with a WHERE id > X AND id <= Y pattern

mike: +1 advisory. full locks will blow up traffic. how are we coordinating chunk boundaries across shards?

anya: chunk boundaries generated by the backfill job using consistent hashing: `SELECT min(id), max(id) FROM orders WHERE shard_id = $1` then split into ~100k ranges. jobs run with rate limiter at 50 qps per worker

sam: ok. can we add a guard that pauses backfill if p99 write latency > 200ms? want quick kill switch

ops-runner: yes, prometheus alert `prod.write_latency_p99 > 200` wired to pager and backfill controller will stop on that signal. also we have `backfill.pause` feature flag if manual pause needed

irene: service side: pin schema version to `v2.3.1` in deploy until backfill complete. env var: `SCHEMA_COMPAT=2.3.1` applied in the canary and then traffic ramp

deploy-bot: Canary deploy: perf-svc@canary -> 3 instances, traffic 5% for 15m. Logs pushed to #eng-releases-canary.

mike: rollback plan: if schema swap fails, we perform a reverse swap using the old migration script (idempotent downgrade) and revert service to `perf-svc@prev` which is already tagged. DB downgrade script ready at migrations/175450-downgrade.sql

anya: note: downgrade will not undo backfilled computed columns, plan is to keep backfill idempotent by writing to shadow column and only swap names at end

sam: can we include a quick SQL snippet in runbook for manual kill? e.g.:
```
-- pause backfill by setting rate to 0
UPDATE backfill_jobs SET rate_limit = 0 WHERE job_name = 'orders_recompute';
```

irene: added to runbook. also added a small script to check progress: `./scripts/backfill_status.sh shards-01` returns percent per shard

ops-runner: scheduled change window 02:00-05:00 UTC tonight. ops oncall: irene + sam. infra oncall: mike

mike: will monitor replica lag. if lag > 5s we abort and roll back. also coordinating with CDN invalidation team just in case computed fields affect edge caches

deploy-bot: Update: canary healthy at 10m, no errors, write p99 steady at 110ms. Starting shard-01 backfill (range 0..100000) at 02:12 UTC

sam: thanks. keep notes in the runbook during steps (samples of queries, row counts)

irene: Will do. tagging postmortem channel for any followup. :party_parrot: 

anya: one more: marking migrations as applied with `meta.migrations` table entry with `safe=true` only after all shards report completed. prevents accidental auto-rollforward

ops-runner: all set. ping if we need manual DB locks but aim to avoid them. good luck team. :thumbsup:
